description: Source code implementing a pluggable CUDA memory allocator for PyTorch, including class definitions, allocator setup, and memory management functions.

classes.name: _AllocationMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for allocated CUDA memory, including size, device index, and stream.

classes.name: CUDAPluggableAllocator
classes.description: A CUDA memory allocator that allows external function registration for allocation, deallocation, and other memory management operations.

methods.name: set_init_fn
methods.description: Sets the initialization function for the allocator.

methods.name: set_reset_fn
methods.description: Sets the reset function to clear or reset the allocator.

methods.name: set_memory_fraction_fn
methods.description: Sets the function to control memory fraction limits.

methods.name: set_base_alloc_fn
methods.description: Sets the base allocation function.

methods.name: set_record_stream_fn
methods.description: Sets the function to record CUDA streams.

methods.name: set_begin_allocate_to_pool
methods.description: Sets the callback for beginning allocation to a memory pool.

methods.name: set_end_allocate_to_pool_fn
methods.description: Sets the callback for ending allocation to a memory pool.

methods.name: set_release_pool
methods.description: Sets the callback to release a memory pool.

methods.name: malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory on a specific device and stream.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory and returns a DataPtr.

methods.name: raw_deleter
methods.description: Returns the function pointer for raw deletion of memory.

methods.name: raw_alloc
methods.description: Allocates raw memory of specified size.

methods.name: raw_alloc_with_stream
methods.description: Allocates raw memory with a specific CUDA stream.

methods.name: raw_delete
methods.description: Deletes memory pointed to by ptr.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the allocator with device count.

methods.name: getMemoryFraction
methods.description: Gets the memory fraction; not supported yet.

methods.name: setMemoryFraction
methods.description: Sets the memory fraction limit.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Empties the cache, resetting the allocator.

methods.name: cacheInfo
methods.description: Provides cache info; not supported yet.

methods.name: getBaseAllocation
methods.description: Returns the base allocation for a pointer.

methods.name: recordStream
methods.description: Records a CUDA stream for a DataPtr.

methods.name: getDeviceStats
methods.description: Gets device stats; not supported yet.

methods.name: resetAccumulatedStats
methods.description: Resets accumulated stats; not supported yet.

methods.name: resetPeakStats
methods.description: Resets peak stats; not supported yet.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of allocator state; not supported yet.

methods.name: shareIpcHandle
methods.description: Shares an IPC handle; not supported yet.

methods.name: getIpcDevPtr
methods.description: Gets device pointer from IPC handle; not supported yet.

methods.name: beginAllocateToPool
methods.description: Begins allocation to a memory pool.

methods.name: endAllocateToPool
methods.description: Ends allocation to a memory pool.

methods.name: releasePool
methods.description: Releases a memory pool.

methods.name: recordHistory
methods.description: Records allocation history; not supported yet.

methods.name: attachOutOfMemoryObserver
methods.description: Attaches an OOM observer; not supported yet.

methods.name: attachAllocatorTraceTracker
methods.description: Attaches an allocator trace tracker; only used inside PyTorch.

methods.name: getCheckpointState
methods.description: Gets checkpoint state; not supported yet.

methods.name: setCheckpointPoolState
methods.description: Sets checkpoint pool state; not supported yet.

methods.name: enablePeerAccess
methods.description: Enables peer access between devices.

methods.name: memcpyAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous device-to-device memory copy.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the allocator name.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies data between device memory.
